description.p: Publishing high-quality research on complex atmospheric processes and their impact on the climate.

npj Climate and Atmospheric Science is a fully open-access journal that aims to highlight the latest developments in the physical, chemical and biological components of atmospheric and climate science.

npj Climate and Atmospheric Science covers topics including, but not limited to, climate dynamics, climate variability, weather and climate prediction, climate change, ocean dynamics, weather extremes, air pollution, atmospheric chemistry including aerosols, the hydrological cycle and atmosphere–ocean and atmosphere–land interactions, and the techniques used to study these, including numerical and statistical modeling, in situ observational techniques and remote sensing.
In addition to original research, the journal welcomes critical Reviews, Meeting Reports, and thought-provoking Perspectives and Comment articles.
